correctness.rationale: I reconstructed f=(xy+1/2)^2+x(1-x+a x²), the actual bounded branch interval r±=(1±sqrt(1−4a))/(2a), and vertical height 2sqrt((x−1−ax²)/x). Substitution z=ax and a standard sine-square elliptic reduction yields precisely 4β^(3/2)[(2−m)E−2(1−m)K]/(3a), with parameter m not elliptic modulus. For increasing a the positive heights and admissible interval strictly shrink, proving nesting. DLMF singular expansions K~log(4/sqrt(1−m)), E=1+(1−m)(log(4/sqrt(1−m))−1/2)/2+... produce 4/(3a)+log(a)−1−log16+O(a|log a|); with δ=1/4−a the exact shear-normalized U,V interior approaches U²+V²≤1, whose Jacobian gives 4sqrt(2)πδ. Independently expanded the actual polynomial cofactor to zero and integrated five nontrivial a-values against the elliptic expression at >40-digit precision. The known 2004 existence theorem is explicitly assumed; a regular algebraic oval is not proven to be isolated from just a cofactor check.
